name: Kabane
source:
A mysterious transfer student. 

[spoiler]She is the daughter of [url=/c65345]Tsuzurai Shizuru[/url], who "infiltrated" the facility at her mother's behest.

Died before the story at the hands of her boyfriend, [url=/c60675]Kimaneki Nayuta[/url]. 

She is the original Kabane (樺音), who Kabane (屍) is modelled after. Though they look similar, their personalities are polar opposites.[/spoiler]
